name: University of Jyväskylä
summary: University in Jyväskylä, central Finland; three English bachelor's: sustainable business, project-based software and AI, and early childhood.

handoff.label: How to apply for international bachelor's

ib.text: Everyone must prove English, with no waivers: an IB Diploma completed in English, English A, or English B at 5 counts. Selection rules differ by programme and are in the Studyinfo criteria.

dates.label: IB predicted grades due on Studyinfo (time to be announced)
Official final IB grades due, and deadline to accept your place

programmes.name: Business Innovation and Sustainability
programmes.about: Science-based business studies focused on sustainability, international business, corporate responsibility, innovation management, strategy and entrepreneurship. Admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.
programmes.ib: Certificate-based admission (group I) on IB grades; results by 28 May 2027.

needs.note: National business threshold: grade 2 in any IB maths.

programmes.selectionNote: Group 1: 12 places ranked on IB grades with the national business table, 10 kept for first-time applicants. The other 18 go on SAT (1100+) or ACT (22+).

programmes.name: Immersive Software Engineering and AI
programmes.about: Software engineering, artificial intelligence, mathematics and entrepreneurship learned through projects in small teams instead of lectures, with two paid internships in IT companies.
programmes.ib: Online admission test, 10–11 February 2027, then online interviews, 17–24 March 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: An online exam (10–11 Feb 2027) on problem solving, maths and English picks about 100 applicants for an online interview. IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Early Childhood Education
programmes.about: Research-based studies of childhood and early childhood education with supervised teaching practice, qualifying you as an early childhood teacher in Finland; Finnish is built into the degree.
programmes.ib: SAT (1100+) or ACT (22+) is needed to reach the online interview, 17–24 March 2027; IB grades are not used. Finnish is taught within the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on SAT or ACT; about three to four times as many as there are places get an online interview, and the interview score decides.

notes: Early Childhood Education is functionally bilingual: taught in English with Finnish built in, and it qualifies you to work as an early childhood teacher in Finland.
Immersive Software Engineering and AI replaces lectures with project work and includes two four-month company internships.
Only Business Innovation and Sustainability ranks on IB grades, and only 12 of its 30 places; the other two programmes select by exam or SAT/ACT plus interview.
